post.summary: Receive a budget decision from the partner system
post.description: No bearer token: the request is authenticated by an HMAC signature of the raw body. X-Signature must be `sha256=` followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256 of `<X-Timestamp>.<body>`, keyed by the shared webhook secret, and X-Timestamp must be within the configured tolerance (5 minutes by default). Delivering the same eventId again is acknowledged as DUPLICATE without applying the decision twice.

parameters.name: X-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time, in seconds, when the request was signed
